rules.rationale: A module that no component owns escapes every rule below.
A component uses another component only where requires says so; absence forbids. This is the crate direction of AD-327 and the module direction of each collector.
Components stay layered: facts, wire and snapshot are the base, and the flow of a collector is above its parts.
Modules use each other in one direction, so a module is read, tested and moved after the modules it uses; the component rule cannot see a cycle inside one component.
Only a collector parses source with Tree-sitter; no library crate does.
Only the TypeScript collector loads the TypeScript grammar.
Only the Rust collector parses Rust source with syn.
Only a grammar crate links a C parser to a Tree-sitter language; a collector gets the language from the grammar crate.
